description:
[Servers] Search every Rust server ConVar (config builder). Every ConVar of the current Rust dedicated server build, as on servers.rustprofit.com/config-builder. Each row:
`name`, `type` (bool/int/float/string), `default` (null = set at runtime), `min`/`max` (the range Rust clamps
to), `category`, `help` (the game's own help text), `note` (our explanation, essential settings only),
`essential`, `published_in` (where the outside world sees it, null when it isn't published), `goes_on`
(`command line` or `server.cfg`), `danger` (why changing it can break a public server), `secret` (a credential
the builder never writes) and `flags`. Alphabetical; essential settings in page order when `essential=true`. For 'what does <setting> do / what is the default' on a Rust server. Then build_server_config.

category.description: Only one config-builder category (key from `/servers/config/presets`), e.g. `decay`, `upkeep`, `gather`, `map`.

essential.description: `true` = only the essential settings the page shows first, with our longer notes.

published.description: `true` = only settings the server publishes to the server browser (A2S); `false` = only unpublished ones.

q.description: Words to find in the ConVar name, the game's help text or our note.

name: search_server_convars
title: Search every Rust server ConVar (config builder)
